alert.message: Health check found degraded services: PM2 process whisper is stopped; Docker containers lidaros-frontend-1 and omiximo-email-automation are unhealthy; langfuse_langfuse-web_1 is restarting; OpenClaw gateway service config is out of date and systemd runtime reports inactive even though RPC probe on 127.0.0.1:18789 is responding.
alert.action: Investigate unhealthy/restarting containers, confirm whether whisper should be running, and repair or remove the stale OpenClaw systemd service (recommended: openclaw doctor or openclaw gateway install --force) while preserving the currently responding local gateway.
